Name: Supply Crates for All
Author: rachelmharrison
Description:
No longer are supply crates confined to the beach farm!

There is a small chance 1-2 crates will spawn each day. The crates will stick around for 3 days before disappearing. Like on the beach farm, the contents of crates will vary based on how many times your farmhouse has been upgraded (see details [url=https://www.stardewvalleywiki.com/Supply_Crate]here[/url]).

Manifest.Name: Supply Crates for All
Manifest.Description: Spawns supply crates on the regular beach, regardless of farm type.
